selection.rule: First five photo-kind assets by ascending SHA-256 among board origins, selected before viewing the five full images; no model output was used.

scope: Source-photo visibility review only. No inference, fitting, training, masks, precise corner labels, split changes or new downloads. This is not an independent human annotation audit.

rows.motifDescription: Drum, red and gold-looking paper on wood
observations: Strong spatial illumination changes and creasing across both sheets.
Both lobe outlines extend outside the photograph; this is not evidence that the overlap square itself is wholly unobservable.
Small triangular details and physical gaps require source/template review before assigning regular-slit ground truth.
rows.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of original-source image

observations: The bottom tip continues beyond the image.
The thin blue/yellow offset along the lower edge is physical sheet/background evidence, not automatically a desired mask stripe.
rows.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of original-source image

observations: The heart points left; its tip is clipped at the left edge and the red lobe is clipped at the top.
The white lobe has weak contrast against the pale background.
Apparent point contacts need tolerance/visibility labels rather than assuming every dark photographic seam is part of the design.
rows.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of original-source image

observations: Both lobes touch or continue outside the frame; the lower tip is visible.
Broad reflection changes occur across the silver-looking sheet.
Strips visibly bow out of plane; a single homography cannot remove that nonplanar distortion.
rows.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of original-source image

observations: The tip is clipped at the bottom and part of the right lobe extends outside the frame.
Reflections and shade change both paper appearances; the handle is a separate visible region.
rows.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of original-source image

summary.qualification: These five observations do not estimate prevalence across the board. Body/lobe clipping and overlap-square visibility are distinct.

implication: Future corner proposals need explicit observation/visibility uncertainty. Compare all errors on the same observed source region; an invented off-image corner or missing source pixels must not be treated as exact training or evaluation truth. Retain native RGB for paper classification and independently check reconstructed templates.
trainingUse: None; inherited QA reservation remains in place.
